name: Declaration on entrusting work to a foreigner (oświadczenie o powierzeniu wykonywania pracy cudzoziemcowi) -- simplified procedure

requirements.blocker_text: Only nationals of Armenia, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova, and Ukraine can be employed under this simplified declaration procedure.
requirements.fix_path: Use the standard Single Permit route if not a national of one of these 5 countries.

requirements.blocker_text: The work cannot be seasonal work (that requires the separate Type S permit) and cannot be a management-board, proxy (prokurent), or general-partner role.
requirements.fix_path: Confirm the role is neither seasonal nor a management/board function; use pl_seasonal_work or pl_business_activity instead if it is.

requirements.blocker_text: The Polish employer must register the declaration through the praca.gov.pl portal with the district labour office (starosta), which enters it into the register within roughly 7 business days for straightforward cases.
requirements.fix_path: Secure an employer willing to register the declaration on praca.gov.pl and pay the PLN 400 filing fee.

evidence_required.document: Registered declaration entry number from the district labour office
Valid residence title covering the work period
Written employment contract matching declared terms

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: work must begin within 6 months of the declaration being registered

sources.title: Ministerstwo Rodziny, Pracy i Polityki Społecznej (praca.gov.pl portal) -- Oświadczenia o powierzeniu wykonywania pracy cudzoziemcowi

Zielona Linia (Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy-run public information line) -- registration conditions for the declaration procedure, independent cross-check of the 24-month cap and 6-month start window
Urząd Pracy m.st. Warszawy (district labour office, Wortal PSZ) -- confirming the PLN 400 filing fee and the 2026 minimum-wage floor

notes: LIVE DISCREPANCY CAUGHT: several secondary sources (e.g. cgomobility.pl) list the eligible-nationality set as 6 countries including Russia. The official Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy page (psz.praca.gov.pl), fetched directly, lists exactly 5: Armenia, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova, and Ukraine -- Russia is not included. This is treated as the authoritative tier-1 figure and the 6-country secondary claim is flagged as stale/incorrect rather than reconciled by assumption, consistent with this project's sourcing discipline. Workers employed at least 3 months under a declaration can subsequently obtain a full work permit without leaving the country, per the same official page -- a soft on-ramp from this simplified procedure to pl_single_permit that isn't modeled as a formal switchable_to prerequisite chain but is worth surfacing on any UI Journey view for this route. This route sits structurally parallel to pl_seasonal_work: both are simplified, capped, non-PR-accruing channels distinct from the full Single Permit, but declaration procedure covers ordinary (non-seasonal) work while Type S covers seasonal work exclusively -- the two are explicitly mutually exclusive by design, not overlapping alternatives, confirmed by the same official source stating seasonal work 'is not permissible under a registered declaration.'
